findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: portfolio_overview, search_stonewake_docs, company_records, developments · Private data: portfolio_overview, portfolio_import_preview, search_companies, search_stonewake_docs, company_financials, company_events, company_records · Public sink: portfolio_book · Destructive: search_stonewake_docs, screening_lookup, developments.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: portfolio_overview, search_stonewake_docs, company_records, developments · Private data: portfolio_overview, portfolio_import_preview, search_companies, search_stonewake_docs, company_financials, company_events, company_records · Public sink: portfolio_book · Destructive: search_stonewake_docs, screening_lookup, developments

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
